sections.title: Your business comes first.
sections.description: A personal discussion with Tejas Parikh.
sections.body:
Vedic astrology uses a traditional interpretation of birth charts and planetary cycles. In a business consultation, those interpretations are discussed in the context of your company, your plans and your specific questions.

The session starts with what is happening in your enterprise. Tejas Parikh considers the relevant birth details and business context, then discusses observations and the questions they raise.

sections.title: Your business comes first.
sections.description: A personal discussion with Tejas Parikh.
sections.body:
A factory or office is a working environment with real operational requirements. A Vastu consultation brings a traditional spatial perspective to the site plan while taking those requirements into account.

The review can cover the main entrance, orientation, production areas, storage and office zones. The scope depends on the property and the information available. Any structural, electrical or machinery changes require qualified professional assessment.

sections.title: Make the most of your consultation.
sections.description: What to share before your session

sections.title: Your business comes first.
sections.description: A personal discussion with Tejas Parikh.
sections.body:
Numerology assigns traditional interpretations to numbers associated with names and dates. A business consultation can focus on a company name, a brand identity or a specific milestone.

Bring the exact spellings you use and explain the business behind the name. We discuss the interpretation and its limits alongside practical branding considerations. Trademark checks and legal availability remain separate professional checks.
